rationale: All four prior blocking findings verified resolved against current source at HEAD f6d1c0e. CR-001/CR-002: Toolkit.tsx now gates default-tool routing on context !== undefined (fixing ToolSelector/SkillForm regression) and on isDefaultToolContextAttached before toggling (fixing the invisible premature-deselect), each confirmed by a new unit test exercising the exact scenario. CR-004: findExclusivePairTool now anchors the default-tool side on a centralized DEFAULT_TOOL_LABEL constant instead of raw backend label text, with tests covering all three pairs plus a label-drift case. CR-003: a new AssistantTab.defaultTools.test.tsx renders the real AssistantTab/VirtualAssistantForm save path and asserts deselected_default_tools reaches the saved actor config, matching the live code at AssistantTab.tsx:233 (not itself modified, since only test coverage was missing). No new findings introduced; no findings remain unresolved.

finding_status.notes: Toolkit.tsx onChange now calls toggleDefaultTool only when isDefaultToolContextAttached(tool.name, context) is true, confirmed by a new test asserting no toggle call and unchanged unchecked state when context is empty.

isDefaultToolRoutable requires context !== undefined; ToolSelector.tsx and SkillForm.tsx render ToolsConfiguration without a context prop, so the reserved-name tools now fall through to the ordinary toggleTool path there, confirmed by a new test mirroring that exact call shape.

New AssistantTab.defaultTools.test.tsx renders the real AssistantTab component (assistants: [] forces the virtual-assistant branch) and asserts the saved actor's deselected_default_tools matches VirtualAssistantForm.getValues() output, exercising AssistantTab.tsx:233 directly.

findExclusivePairTool now resolves the default-tool side's label from a single DEFAULT_TOOL_LABEL constant instead of raw tool.label, with new tests covering all three default-tool pairs and a label-drift regression case.
